run-in: Steer the run-in onto the target.
speed-guidance: Fly the speed it asks for.
contingency: Out of time for the IP? Go direct.
define-target: Pick the target where you stand.
define-ip: Set the IP by bearing and distance.
push-countdown: Hold, then push on the count.
ground: Brief the run before you start.
tot-entry: Key in the time on target.
